about: Quick checks for the questions that come up most about IRL streaming, written as checks along the chain: camera and mic, sender, connections, receiver, OBS, platform. Fields: id (an anchor), question, summary (which part most likely broke), checks (1 to 3; each has short plain text and optionally the part it looks at; no product names or product settings), words (ids in words.json), services (ids in services.json whose own docs and support channels help with the question), sources (the primary docs behind the checks; at least one required). Product specifics live in guides.json and services.json, never in the checks. Our own words only; no community posts quoted or linked. Validated by the zod schema in ../schema.

answers.question: My app says I'm live, but the platform shows me offline
answers.summary: Your app may send to a hub: a cloud OBS, a relay with drop protection or OBS at home. The hub goes live on the platform with its own Start.

checks.text: Check where your app sends. If it's a hub, live in the app only means the hub is receiving.
Start the hub's output: Start Streaming in OBS, or the start button or command of your cloud service.
Check that a destination is added and switched on, and watch the platform's dashboard during a test.
